Corresponding source for ASCII Camera's GIF Worker

gifenc 1.0.3
Published: 2021-03-07T11:09:20.659Z
Release commit: 15e2c3e65ed03c977b42fec48de59b05ee9b9f54
https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc/tree/15e2c3e65ed03c977b42fec48de59b05ee9b9f54

The src/ files and package.json are copied byte for byte from the locked npm
package. src/ also matches sourcesContent in its published CJS and ESM maps.
No algorithm or source edits have been made by ASCII Camera.

The package declares MIT, Copyright (c) 2017 Matt DesLauriers.
Its src/pnnquant2.js is a modification of PnnQuant.js, whose historical
source and MPL-2.0 license are available at:
https://github.com/mcychan/PnnQuant.js/tree/0dc2664d2d9582d1b6b492936bdd03687e385275
This historical commit is dated 2021-02-25, before gifenc's import.

The PNN-derived source in src/pnnquant2.js is made available under the Mozilla
Public License, version 2.0. See LICENSE.MPL-2.0.txt. gifenc's contributions
also retain the upstream package's MIT notice in LICENSE.MIT.txt.
Other gifenc source files retain the package's MIT license and notices.

Original PNN notices, also preserved in src/pnnquant2.js:
Copyright (C) 2004-2019 Mark Tyler and Dmitry Groshev
Copyright (c) 2018-2021 Miller Cy Chan

The adaptation introduced an ES module interface, RGB packing helpers and
options, followed by gifenc's 2021 optimizations. The exact imported upstream
commit was not recorded by gifenc; the historical reference above is a
verifiable pre-import snapshot, not an assertion of byte-identical import.

This source is provided beside the production Worker, at no charge.
Source and license rights under MPL-2.0 are not restricted by ASCII Camera's
MIT license. ASCII Camera's own separate source files remain MIT licensed.
See source-manifest.json for SHA-256 hashes of the exact source files.
